places.name: Empress Botanical Garden

places.name: Shaniwar Wada
places.summary: The Peshwa palace the district dates to 1736. The same page says an 1828 fire left the walls.
places.note: District tourism says Bajirao I built Shaniwar Wada in 1736 as the Peshwas’ headquarters. It names Delhi Darwaja as the main entrance, with other gates called Ganesh, Mastani, Jambhal, and Khidki. It also says a fire in 1828 destroyed the palace and that what remains are the fortified walls. The “13 storey” line on that page describes the original palace, not a tower to climb now. State tourism likewise calls it the Peshwas’ seat and records the 1828 fire. The district mentions a daily light-and-music show; the schedule is not repeated, because it was not reconfirmed. The road note says 3–4 km from Pune railway station. No gate-by-gate visiting instructions are added here.

places.name: Sinhagad
places.summary: Kondhana, renamed after the battle the district retells. Not a current permit to climb.
places.note: District tourism locates this fort at Donaje village in Haveli taluka and gives its earlier name as Kondhana. It retells the battle associated with Tanaji Malusare and prints the gloss that the fort was won but the lion was lost. State tourism tells that history too and describes a hill fort southwest of Pune. The pages do not agree on distance or height. The district introduction says 25 km and 1,290 metres; its road note says 35–40 km. The state fort page says about 35 km and 1,312 metres, and another block on that page prints still other kilometre figures. This guide does not choose one and does not turn any of them into a journey time. Current access is not established. Do not read a motorable-road sentence, a trek duration, or a best-season line as permission for today. No trail, night approach, or monsoon plan is described here. Look at current district notices and the Maharashtra Forest Department before you go. No open-or-closed order for Sinhagad was confirmed on 7 November 2026.

This guide does not pick one and does not estimate the drive. It does not describe a place to swim, boat, or walk to the water, because the page does not.
